title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) logs full practice Friday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson was a full participant in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Parkinson is on track to be good to go. He is off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) placed on injured reserve
items.desc: Pat Bryant (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve and will be out for the next four weeks at least.
items.impact: Bryant recently suffered an ankle injury, and it is serious enough that the team is placing him on short-term injured reserve. That means that he will be sidelined for the next four weeks at least, but it sounds like he's expected to make his return sometime not too long after that. Troy Franklin and Courtland Sutton are both likely to see more work for the Broncos for the foreseeable future in his absence.

items.title: Charvarius Ward (groin) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Charvarius Ward (groin) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Ward may not be available to play on Sunday, as he is officially questionable to play due to the groin injury that he's managing. Indianapolis' secondary will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darius Slayton (knee) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Darius Slayton (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Slayton is a new addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He was added with a knee injury on Friday and is now considered questionable to play in Week 5. He only plays a depth role for the Colts right now, but his absence would still be less than ideal with Ashton Dulin (hamstring) out and Keenan Allen (groin) questionable to suit up against Pittsburgh.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Gordon (calf) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Kyler Gordon (calf) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: The young defensive back may be available to make his season debut on Sunday. He's officially considered questionable, but he was able to practice in full all week and seems to strongly be trending in the right direction. Chicago's secondary will see a nice boost if he's back in the lineup against Green Bay this week.
